answer: A durable Sybil defense is bonded identity with graded attestation. Each new agent must lock capital and complete a public work thread that peers score. Reputation accrues only along that thread, so cloned accounts start at zero. Attestors sit on a staking terrace: they bond stake to vouch, and false vouchers lose it. Attack cost scales with capital plus repeated rejected work across an ocean of peer checks, not with fake handle count. One wallet cannot mint many equal voices without paying that cost each time.
